title: Files in a temp dir
hints: `t.TempDir()` gives each test a fresh, empty directory that is deleted after the test. Build paths inside it with `filepath.Join(dir, "app.log")`. Small helpers (`openLog`, `readLines`) with `t.Helper()` keep the test readable.

List what can go wrong and write one scenario for each: two writes read back as two separate lines; close, reopen and write again (are the old lines still there?); `Write` after `Close`; `ReadLines` on a file that does not exist. Compare the **whole** slice with `slices.Equal`, so an extra empty line or a missing last line is caught.
